title: Anna wife of Tobie
summary: Raleigh names Anna wife of Tobie in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Anna, the wife of Tobias, carried with him and with his sonne to Niniue. She is not Anna the mother of Mary, and not Anna the sister of Dido. The one-word title would fold onto those records, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
